# Corpus v0 - vendored sources

Generated by `tools/vendor_corpus.ps1` from `tools/corpus.lock.json`. Do not edit by hand.

These are third-party deliberately-insecure IaC repositories, vendored at
exact commits for evaluation reproducibility. Original licenses apply and
each upstream license file is retained alongside the vendored tree.

Vendored trees hold the bytes upstream committed: each cache clone is checked
out with `core.autocrlf=false` and `core.eol=lf`, so no line-ending conversion
happens on the way in. `.gitattributes` normalizes `corpus/**` to LF in this
index; for both pins below every upstream blob is already LF, so that
normalization is a no-op and the committed blob ids equal the upstream ones.
